method.name: InspectPublication
method.summary: Inspects the recorded recovery state for one publication session without verifying or modifying external artifacts.
method.param: Request containing the transfer session identifier.
method.returns: The recovery footprint; the response status indicates whether the session was found.

method.name: CloseTransferSession
method.summary: Closes a retained read transfer session when it has no active dependents or publication recovery state.
method.param: Session and item identity requested for closure.
Optional bearer token with catalog read access.
method.returns: Response indicating whether the session was closed; status indicates authorization or lifecycle conflicts.

method.name: PurgePublication
method.summary: Requests a confirmed purge of one session's staging artifacts and DataControl recovery state.
method.remarks: Final published artifacts and catalog data are not removed by this operation.
method.param: Confirmed request containing expected session and optional journal freshness values.
method.returns: The purge result; the response status indicates whether the expected state matched.

method.name: AbortTransfer
method.summary: Abort an active segmented or stream upload session. Read-only sessions must be closed with CloseTransferSession.
method.returns: AbortTransferResponse. StatusCode indicates result.

method.name: PublishStreamTransfer
method.summary: Complete and publish a stream transfer source session.
method.returns: PublishStreamTransferResponse. StatusCode indicates result.

method.name: PublishSegmentedTransfer
method.summary: Publish a segmented transfer session.
method.returns: PublishSegmentedTransferResponse. StatusCode indicates result.

method.name: Download
method.summary: Download or follow content through the working-directory-backed client flow. Cancellation pauses the download and retains its local session for resumption; no partial item is returned.
method.param: Optional progress sink first notified with the persisted session identity and current byte state, then after each successfully downloaded and persisted range or stream extent.
method.returns: A materialized download result, or null when the download could not be completed.
method.remarks: When cancellation is requested, the task throws ; use the session ID from progress or local session inventory with to continue.

method.name: Delete
method.summary: Delete Object.
method.returns: Object ID. StatusCode indicates result.

method.name: DeleteLocalSession
method.summary: Delete persisted local transfer session artifacts from the configured working-directory root.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the local session was deleted; otherwise false.

method.name: GetStreamTransferSegment
method.summary: Retrieve a stream-transfer payload and trailing footer.
method.returns: Stream-transfer download result, including payload and parsed footer.

method.name: GetStreamTransferState
method.summary: Retrieve the current state of a stream transfer session.
method.returns: GetStreamTransferStateResponse. StatusCode indicates result.

method.name: OpenFollowStreamTransfer
method.summary: Open a stream follower read session over an active stream transfer source session.
method.returns: OpenFollowStreamTransferResponse. StatusCode indicates result.

method.name: OpenStreamTransfer
method.summary: Open a new stream transfer source session.
method.returns: OpenStreamTransferResponse. StatusCode indicates result.

method.name: GetTransferSegment
method.summary: Retrieve a segmented transfer payload and trailing footer.
method.returns: Segment download result, including payload and parsed footer.

method.name: PutStreamTransferSegment
method.summary: Append to a stream transfer using the binary transfer envelope.
method.returns: Stream append response with HTTP status and parsed payload.

method.name: GetTransferState
method.summary: Retrieve the current state of a segmented transfer session.
method.returns: GetTransferStateResponse. StatusCode indicates result.

method.name: GetTransferIntegrityEvidence
method.summary: Retrieve authoritative integrity evidence for a transfer prefix.
method.returns: Integrity evidence response. StatusCode indicates result.

method.name: GetLocalSession
method.summary: Retrieve information about a single persisted local transfer session.
method.returns: A task that completes with local session information, or null when the session is not present.

method.name: GetLocalSessions
method.summary: Enumerate persisted local transfer sessions under the configured working-directory root.
method.returns: A task that completes with the discovered local transfer sessions.

method.name: GetServerSessions
method.summary: Retrieve transfer session inventory using the optional administrative filters.
method.returns: Server transfer session inventory response. StatusCode indicates result.

method.name: ReOpenFollowStreamTransfer
method.summary: Reopen an existing stream follower read session.
method.returns: ReOpenFollowStreamTransferResponse. StatusCode indicates result.

method.name: OpenDownload
method.summary: Open a client download or follow session backed by the configured working directory.
method.returns: A resumable download session, or null when the session could not be opened.

method.name: ReOpenStreamTransfer
method.summary: Reopen an existing stream transfer source session.
method.returns: ReOpenStreamTransferResponse. StatusCode indicates result.

method.name: OpenGetTransfer
method.summary: Open a segmented read session for published or staged content.
method.returns: OpenGetTransferResponse. StatusCode indicates result.

method.name: Upload
method.summary: Upload content through the working-directory-backed client flow.
method.param: Optional progress sink that receives an update after each successfully accepted segment or appended stream extent.
method.returns: A completed upload result, or null when the upload could not be completed.

method.name: OpenUploadTransfer
method.summary: Open a new segmented transfer session.
method.returns: OpenUploadTransferResponse. StatusCode indicates result.

method.name: OpenUpload
method.summary: Open a client upload session backed by the configured working directory.
method.returns: A resumable upload session, or null when the session could not be opened.

method.name: PutTransferSegment
method.summary: Upload a segmented transfer range using the binary segment envelope.
method.returns: Segment upload response with HTTP status and parsed payload.

method.name: ReOpenUploadTransfer
method.summary: Reopen an existing segmented transfer session.
method.returns: ReOpenUploadTransferResponse. StatusCode indicates result.

method.name: ReOpenGetTransfer
method.summary: Reopen an existing segmented read session.
method.returns: ReOpenGetTransferResponse. StatusCode indicates result.

method.name: ResumeDownload
method.summary: Resume a persisted download session from local working-directory state using the session kind already captured in local metadata.
method.remarks: Only one download session instance or process may use a given local session at a time. Dispose the existing instance before resuming it; concurrent access to the same working-directory state is not coordinated.
method.param: Resume options that control completion behavior and optional live stream-item rebinding. Persisted session state determines the actual download mode.
method.returns: A task that completes with a resumed download session, or null when the session cannot be resumed.

method.name: ResumeUpload
method.summary: Resume a persisted upload session from local working-directory state.
method.returns: A task that completes with a resumed upload session, or null when the session cannot be resumed.

method.name: RemoveTransfer
method.summary: Remove retained transfer session artifacts after completion.
method.returns: Remove response.
